title: Images are data
description: Convert each message to a real NumPy array, print its shape and report the three channel means.
steps: Convert the Image message with CvBridge.
Print image.shape and calculate the mean of each RGB channel.
Call report_image_stats with the shape and three means.
hints: Use CvBridge.imgmsg_to_cv2 with desired_encoding="rgb8".
The array shape is height × width × channels.
A channel mean is image[:, :, 0].mean(). Compute one for each channel.
report_image_stats(image.shape, [image[:, :, i].mean() for i in range(3)])

content.title: Image buffers and pixel indexing
content.description: Read the contiguous RGB byte buffer. Use image dimensions and row stride to calculate the three channel means.
steps: Read msg->data, width, height and step. Each rgb8 pixel contains red, green and blue bytes.
Loop over rows and columns. Accumulate each channel and divide by the pixel count.
Call kinenest::report_image_stats with {height, width, 3} and the three calculated means.
hints: step is the number of bytes per row; width is the number of pixels.
The byte offset is y * msg->step + 3 * x + channel. Channel indices are 0, 1 and 2.
Store sums in std::array<double, 3>; divide by double(width) * height before reporting.

nl.title: Beeldbuffers en pixelindexering
nl.description: Lees de aaneengesloten RGB-bytebuffer. Gebruik de afmetingen en rijlengte om de drie kanaalgemiddelden te berekenen.
steps: Lees msg->data, width, height en step. Elke rgb8-pixel bevat bytes voor rood, groen en blauw.
Loop over rijen en kolommen. Tel elk kanaal op en deel door het aantal pixels.
Roep kinenest::report_image_stats aan met {height, width, 3} en de drie berekende gemiddelden.
hints: step is het aantal bytes per rij; width is het aantal pixels.
De bytepositie is y * msg->step + 3 * x + channel. Kanaalindices zijn 0, 1 en 2.
Bewaar sommen in std::array<double, 3>; deel vóór het rapporteren door double(width) * height.

fr.title: Buffers d’image et indexation des pixels
fr.description: Lisez le buffer contigu d’octets RGB. Utilisez les dimensions et le pas de ligne pour calculer les trois moyennes des canaux.
steps: Lisez msg->data, width, height et step. Chaque pixel rgb8 contient des octets rouge, vert et bleu.
Parcourez les lignes et colonnes. Additionnez chaque canal puis divisez par le nombre de pixels.
Appelez kinenest::report_image_stats avec {height, width, 3} et les trois moyennes calculées.
hints: step est le nombre d’octets par ligne ; width est le nombre de pixels.
L’indice d’octet est y * msg->step + 3 * x + channel. Les indices des canaux sont 0, 1 et 2.
Stockez les sommes dans std::array<double, 3> ; divisez par double(width) * height avant de les rapporter.

es.title: Búferes de imagen e índices de píxeles
es.description: Lee el búfer contiguo de bytes RGB. Usa las dimensiones y el tamaño de fila para calcular las tres medias de los canales.
steps: Lee msg->data, width, height y step. Cada píxel rgb8 contiene bytes rojo, verde y azul.
Recorre filas y columnas. Suma cada canal y divide por el número de píxeles.
Llama a kinenest::report_image_stats con {height, width, 3} y las tres medias calculadas.
hints: step es el número de bytes por fila; width es el número de píxeles.
El índice de byte es y * msg->step + 3 * x + channel. Los canales tienen índices 0, 1 y 2.
Guarda las sumas en std::array<double, 3>; divide por double(width) * height antes de informar.

de.title: Bildpuffer und Pixelindizes
de.description: Lies den zusammenhängenden RGB-Bytepuffer. Berechne die drei Kanalmittelwerte anhand von Bildgröße und Zeilenlänge.
steps: Lies msg->data, width, height und step. Jedes rgb8-Pixel enthält ein rotes, grünes und blaues Byte.
Durchlaufe Zeilen und Spalten. Summiere jeden Kanal und teile durch die Pixelanzahl.
Rufe kinenest::report_image_stats mit {height, width, 3} und den drei berechneten Mittelwerten auf.
hints: step ist die Byteanzahl pro Zeile; width ist die Pixelanzahl.
Der Byteindex ist y * msg->step + 3 * x + channel. Die Kanalindizes sind 0, 1 und 2.
Speichere Summen in std::array<double, 3>; teile vor dem Melden durch double(width) * height.

pt.title: Buffers de imagem e índices de píxeis
pt.description: Lê o buffer contíguo de bytes RGB. Usa as dimensões e o tamanho da linha para calcular as três médias dos canais.
steps: Lê msg->data, width, height e step. Cada píxel rgb8 contém bytes vermelho, verde e azul.
Percorre linhas e colunas. Soma cada canal e divide pelo número de píxeis.
Chama kinenest::report_image_stats com {height, width, 3} e as três médias calculadas.
hints: step é o número de bytes por linha; width é o número de píxeis.
O índice do byte é y * msg->step + 3 * x + channel. Os índices dos canais são 0, 1 e 2.
Guarda as somas em std::array<double, 3>; divide por double(width) * height antes de comunicar.

hints: step è il numero di byte per riga; width è il numero di pixel.
